findings.claim: 2026-07-16 Uber 與 Delivery Hero 簽 Business Combination Agreement，以每股 €41.50 現金公開收購 Delivery Hero 全部股份；Delivery Hero 董事會一致通過。
findings.excerpt: On July 16, 2026, Uber Technologies, Inc. (the “Company” or “Uber”) entered into a Business Combination Agreement (the “BCA”), by and among, the Company, Uber International Technologies II Corporation, a Delaware corporation and a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (the “Bidder”), and Delivery Hero SE

findings.claim: 2026-08-06 Uber 簽 Term Loan Credit Agreement 為 Delivery Hero 收購融資，並將 Bridge Credit Agreement 承諾額度減少 €4,000,000,000。
findings.excerpt: The entry into the Term Loan Credit Agreement reduced the commitments under the Bridge Credit Agreement (as defined below) by €4,000,000,000.

findings.claim: 2026-09-15 Uber 完成 €4.5 億級以上歐元優先無擔保票據公開發行（五檔合計 €4,500,000,000）。
findings.excerpt: On September 15, 2026, Uber Technologies, Inc. (the “Company”) completed a registered public offering of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of the Company’s 3.750% Senior Notes due 2029

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露公司涉多項訴訟與政府調查，含集體訴訟（如澳洲計程車業集體訴訟已和解、無承認責任）。
findings.excerpt: These include individual, multiple plaintiff, and putative class and class action claims for alleged violation of laws related to, among other things, transportation, competition, advertising, consumer protection, fee calculations, personal injuries, privacy, intellectual property, product liability, discrimination, safety, and employment.

note: NHTSA 於 2026-05 調查 Uber 夥伴 Avride（搜尋摘要）；FTC Uber One 訴訟 2025-12 修正起訴加入 21 州＋DC。
